signal: Nextech launched Cora Scribe in January 2026 and expanded its Payments platform with Stripe and Affirm, spotlighting the new Cora AI assistant at EDGE 2026.

email.body1:
Charlie, saw Nextech launched Cora Scribe and expanded the Payments platform with Stripe and Affirm this year.

A bigger product footprint usually means more specialty practices raising their hand than your inside team can work before they go quiet. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Nextech off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Charlie, quick follow-up for Nextech.

As Cora and Payments open new conversations, most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to convert them, so the coverage gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your inside team needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Charlie, last bit of proof for Nextech.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other specialty health-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Charlie, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling inside-sales pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while Cora and Payments bed in, no problem at all. A product push is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an inside-sales motion? I will tailor it to Nextech either way.
